ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High local contrast ratio between a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) base and sparse, high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous base covering approximately 85% of surface; high-contrast white circular and semi-circular blobs are scattered non-uniformly across both lobes, with higher concentrations in the central-medial zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch at the center-line with an estimated pixel angle of 140 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 8% of the visible vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; pixel-level peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal 25% of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve originating from the median notch, tapering to sharp, irregular lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-contrast pixel clusters (approximately 3-12 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes, appearing as white-on-black focal points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal high-intensity linear streak on the upper right lobe; multiple shorter horizontal high-intensity disruptions on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring across the ventral surface; significant irregular edge-loss/notching at the far distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of point-source white circular marks creates a 'starfield' pattern across the dark fluke pigment.
